# Code Ref

## Summary
Base-realm field. Lives at `https://cardstack.com/base/code-ref` (default export). Primitive reference to a code export — `{ module, name }` — the type-pointer used by Spec.ref and meta.adoptsFrom. The module also exports `AbsoluteCodeRefField`.

## Usage
```ts
import CodeRefField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/code-ref';
```

Example: value `{"module": "https://cardstack.com/base/tag", "name": "default"}`
